name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for engineering, nurtured in his father's auto repair shop in Montreal. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he initially worked in the automotive industry before finding his way into Formula 1 through a contact at a testing facility. His methodical approach and sharp eye for detail quickly made him an invaluable asset to various racing teams.

At Red Bull Racing, Jean-Pierre is responsible for orchestrating the entire test driver program, ensuring every session maximizes data collection and driver development. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable feedback for the drivers. Jean-Pierre's distinctive ability to identify subtle nuances in vehicle performance, honed by years of experience, makes him a highly sought-after coordinator.
